_comment: Verified lineage for every child in the M5 sweeps. 'evidence' records WHERE the claim comes from. Three BERT-family labels in the first draft of sweep_bert.py were WRONG; the displacement measure flagged the legal-bert one before the model card was read.

allenai/biomed_roberta_base.evidence: card: 'We adapt RoBERTa-base ... via continued pretraining'

allenai/cs_roberta_base.evidence: INFERRED from the same 'Don't Stop Pretraining' release; model card is empty (21 bytes)

allenai/news_roberta_base.evidence: INFERRED from release; model card empty (21 bytes)

allenai/reviews_roberta_base.evidence: INFERRED from release; model card empty (21 bytes)

cardiffnlp/twitter-roberta-base.evidence: card: 'trained on ~58M tweets on top of the original RoBERTa-base checkpoint'

ProsusAI/finbert.evidence: card: 'built by further training the BERT language model in the finance domain'

textattack/bert-base-uncased-SST-2.evidence: repo name + TextAttack release convention; no card

textattack/bert-base-uncased-imdb.evidence: card: 'This bert-base-uncased model was fine-tuned ... imdb'

csarron/bert-base-uncased-squad-v1.evidence: card: 'fine-tuned from the HuggingFace BERT base uncased'

nlpaueb/legal-bert-base-uncased.evidence: card: 'LEGAL-BERT-SC ... trained from scratch in the legal corpora using a newly created vocabulary'. NOT a derivative. MPK's 'Not Matched' is CORRECT. The FP variants that DO build on BERT-BASE live on archive.org, not the Hub.

microsoft/BiomedNLP-BiomedBERT-base-unca.evidence: card: 'pretrained from scratch using abstracts from PubMed'. NOT a derivative.

emilyalsentzer/Bio_ClinicalBERT.evidence: card: 'initialized from BioBERT'; BioBERT v1.0 derives from bert-base-CASED, so comparing to bert-base-UNCASED is cross-lineage.
